$comment: Starter lexicon: one agreed word per concept for a design system's property and layer names. Copy it into your design system repo as lexicon.json and make it yours. Every entry starts as 'starter'; change it to 'agreed' once your team agrees the word. Adding a word means forbidding its synonyms.

conventions.note: One prefix per system. Mixing has and show is the most common drift.

names.name: headingText
names.means: The first line of text in a component. The loudest thing in it.

names.name: supportingText
names.means: The quieter line under the heading. Explains, never instructs.

names.name: helperText
names.means: Guidance under an input. Becomes the error message when the field is in error.

names.name: placeholderText
names.means: The sample text inside an empty input. Never a substitute for a label.

names.name: icon
names.means: The one icon slot in a component. The component does not know what the icon means or what it does. The consumer says both.
names.note: When a component has two, use leadingIcon and trailingIcon. Never icon plus icon2.

names.name: leadingIcon
names.means: The icon at the start of the reading direction. Left in English, right in Arabic or Hebrew.
names.note: Never left or right. Those words break in right-to-left languages.

names.name: trailingIcon
names.means: The icon at the end of the reading direction.

names.name: listSlot
names.means: The open area a consumer fills with anything. In code this is children.
names.note: A component with one slot may call it contentSlot. Name the slot for what goes in it, not where it sits.

names.name: hasHeading
names.means: Whether the heading block shows. Binds to the smallest frame holding only the heading.

names.name: hasIcon
names.means: Whether the icon shows at all.

names.name: usage
names.means: Where the component sits, which decides its shape only. Never which children appear.
names.note: usage and variant may be the same concept in your system. Decide before a third component uses either.

names.name: size
names.means: How much space the component takes, at one text size.
names.note: Spell the words out. sm, md, lg do not survive a fourth size.

names.name: labelPosition
names.means: Whether the label sits inside the field or above it.

names.name: state
names.means: Documentation of what the component looks like in each state. NOT a code prop.
names.note: hover, focus, pressed and disabled are drawn by the platform. Only error and loading reach the code API.

codeOnly.name: onIconPress
codeOnly.means: Called when the icon is pressed. The component never acts on itself.
codeOnly.note: Named for the part, not for what the consumer does with it. A close card and an expand card share one callback.

codeOnly.name: iconLabel
codeOnly.means: What a screen reader says for the icon. Required whenever an icon shows.
codeOnly.note: The component cannot guess this. A generic icon slot carries no meaning.

codeOnly.name: children
codeOnly.means: The code side of a slot.

bannedEverywhere.left: breaks in right-to-left languages. use leading
bannedEverywhere.right: breaks in right-to-left languages. use trailing
bannedEverywhere.type: reserved in several languages. use variant or usage
